description: Architectural elevation DXF reverse engineering: 2-story 2-bay frame building
message: Extract the structural members from the attached architectural elevation DXF and engineering specification, filter out non-structural building elements, build the calculation model, and run static analysis. Use visible dimensions and structural layers; do not infer missing engineering information.
engineeringSpecification: Material steel: E=205000 MPa, nu=0.3, density=7850 kg/m3. Column members use section HW350x350 (H=350 mm, B=350 mm, tw=12 mm, tf=19 mm; A=0.01739 m2, Iy=0.000403 m4, Iz=0.000136 m4, J=0.00000863 m4, G=79000 MPa). Beam members use section HN500x200 (H=500 mm, B=200 mm, tw=10 mm, tf=16 mm; A=0.01143 m2, Iy=0.000502 m4, Iz=0.0000214 m4, J=0.00000124 m4, G=79000 MPa). Map this elevation's source X/Y axes to global X/Z with global Y=0. Use fixed column bases. Apply separate global-Z downward line loads D=10 kN/m and L=8 kN/m to every floor beam. Use SI units and the global-Z-up coordinate convention, do not add member self-weight, and analyze load combination ULS = 1.2 x D + 1.4 x L.
